pages.title: Summer: props connect the merchandise
pages.body: Fishing rods, hands and folding chairs create a viewing path. Compare product position, prop scale and background contrast so the narrative keeps merchandise legible.

images.caption: Summer window with a fishing rod, folding chair, fish props and a speech bubble
Summer window with a mannequin, drink-shaped prop, orange slice and COOL speech bubble

pages.title: Autumn: familiar frames, unfamiliar scale
pages.body: Doors, windows and walls establish spatial references. Oversized animals disrupt those references while framing and suspension separate merchandise from large props.

images.caption: Autumn window with an oversized pink fish passing through a doorway beside a mannequin
Autumn window with a yellow snail, an open door and a suspended pink bag

pages.title: Winter: different rhythms for different windows
pages.body: Wide windows connect products across snow planes. Tall windows build a vertical hierarchy around the horse. Each format requires a new composition.

images.caption: Wide winter window with a large white horse head, snowy planes, a yellow bag and a small pink horse
Layered white horse contours and suspended accessories against a blue background

pages.title: From visual direction to spatial relationships
pages.body: My contribution was 3D design and visual presentation within BENWU. The retrospective diagram compares composition and merchandise hierarchy; individual production and store-delivery responsibility is not established.

images.caption: From visual direction to spatial relationships

pages.title: Terrain, body and equipment
pages.body: A rock face anchors the background, layered contours form the middle ground and a mannequin establishes human scale. Their boundaries and overlap help equipment remain readable.

images.caption: Arc’teryx Mountain Performance Field | user-supplied retrospective board 01 / 10
Arc’teryx Alpha Center window with rock forms, layered curves and a mannequin holding poles

pages.title: Communicate spatial relationships
pages.body: Compare the rock face, curves and equipment as distinct layers. Window format, lighting and product visibility guide the spatial reading.

images.caption: Return to display scale

pages.title: The window in its retail context
pages.body: Additional installation views connect the window with the interior. Rock, directional lines, mannequins and moss surfaces extend the mountain language around clothing and circulation.

images.caption: Arc’teryx Alpha Center installation, front window
Arc’teryx mountain-performance retail interior

pages.title: Brand foundations
pages.body: Woodcraft, furniture and everyday life frame this retrospective design study. The material does not establish an official commission.

images.caption: Karimoku × BENWU | user-supplied retrospective board 01 / 20

pages.title: A material system
pages.body: Wood, surface, joints and edges organise the material language. Species, finishes and durability require samples and engineering validation.

images.caption: Karimoku × BENWU | user-supplied retrospective board 07 / 20

pages.title: Void and layers
pages.body: Spacing, layers, movement and light connect objects with their photographic representation. These images are design studies.

images.caption: Karimoku × BENWU | user-supplied retrospective board 15 / 20

pages.title: A shared section across different uses
pages.body: Table and floor lights share a linear body, luminous strips and distinctive ends. Support, length and direction change around the use scenario.

images.caption: Silver table lamp with a circular base beside an open book on a blue surface
Full view of a silver floor lamp against black

pages.title: Separate material and functional cues
pages.body: Metal channels, luminous surfaces and circular controls explain different roles. Renderings support comparison of reflection and proportion; optical performance requires testing.

images.caption: Detail of a gold light body with longitudinal light strips and a circular control
Horizontal pendant with parallel light strips, metal channels and end details against a dark background

pages.title: From historical exploration to a private seal
pages.body: The earlier Songnasty exploration and current YELISI mark show a shift in identity language. Seal, folded line and cut-corner forms connect naming, graphics and product context.

images.caption: Historical Songnasty identity exploration
Current Yelisi brand identity

pages.title: Connect identity, products and CMF
pages.body: Collaborative brand and product-concept work shares a material direction. The archive supports comparison of form and surface; no manufacture or market launch is claimed.

Design decisions and system applications (Chinese diagram)

pages.title: Build the system around recognition
pages.body: Compare the photography-equipment context, name recognition and small-scale legibility. The wordmark anchors the visual and information system.

images.caption: Periastra | user-supplied retrospective board 01 / 15
Design decisions and system applications (Chinese diagram)

pages.body: The PERIASTRA wordmark study, dated 9 June 2026, supports comparison of letterforms, hierarchy, application scale and production direction.

pages.title: Understand the service, then take action
pages.body: The VI/UI connects brand expression with service entry points. The homepage introduces the offer before presenting the main action.

images.caption: Biyuan desktop homepage

pages.title: Support browsing and deliberate search
pages.body: Model lists and name search support two different tasks. Hierarchy helps users identify a model, understand its entry point and continue.

images.caption: Biyuan model directory
Filtered model search

pages.title: Preserve the main action on mobile
pages.body: I designed and iterated the VI/UI. The mobile study rearranges content by priority, checking text, actions and scrolling. This archive does not establish ownership of the deployed service.

images.caption: Biyuan mobile homepage

pages.title: A controllable creative workflow
pages.body: A film-language reference, a new story and two character inputs become a storyboard, Blender blocking, controlled imagery and prompts, then a Seedance 2.5 render. The 11 storyboard units and 20+ characters are my process-log counts.

images.caption: Workflow map from case observation to a reviewed output
A Blender blocking frame from the supplied source video used to check camera and cast relations

pages.title: Review relationships, then revise the right layer
pages.body: A searchable reference index, six control layers and eight analyses connect product, CMF, space and narrative. The personal 22.08-second film remains a process record; the page separates source analysis from personal workflow application. Explore Systems / AI video methods on the website.

images.caption: Six control layers for an AI video workflow
Review relationships, then revise the right layer

pages.title: The product as an entry into a wider world
pages.body: A Small Inhaler & A Wider World recombines product, classical figures, architecture and landscape into one surreal visual narrative.

images.caption: The product as an entry into the sky
A figure meets the inhaler in a classical space

pages.title: From a small action to spatial release
pages.body: Tears, scale shifts and the green recognition colour connect the 11 posters into one reading path; original PNGs and the source manifest remain in the web case.

images.caption: A breathing gesture enlarged into a distant opening
The series closes on a wider world

pages.title: Character, action and ink
pages.body: Small gestures trigger ink at landscape scale. The complete script organises eight action passages; the film records the relationship between camera, identity and effects. Open the case to watch.

images.caption: Ink Step: ground-level motion and dry-brush trails
Ink Lotus: layered black ink and muted gold

pages.title: Organise the visual definition around identity
pages.body: Views, expressions, micro-expressions, clothing and hands form a visual definition that can be inspected repeatedly. The full case retains five images and the input template.

images.caption: Character sheet: a shared reference for views and details

pages.title: Light type, direction and visible results
pages.body: Turn lighting into short, inspectable prompts. Nose shadows, wall shadows and hair highlights guide concrete revisions. The full archive retains nine images and every comparison.

images.caption: Soft and hard light: changes in nose and chin shadows

pages.title: Consumer camera and sound first
pages.body: 4:3 Mini DV accident, correct action order and close sound form the coffee vlog method; the online case retains the complete film and prompt.

images.caption: AREN SATO character reference
Extraction and focus search

pages.title: Action order and a domestic close
pages.body: Grinding, tamping, locking, steaming, pouring and drinking stay connected by sound and hard cuts, keeping the rhythm of an ordinary morning.

images.caption: The ending: a sip followed by a covered lens

pages.title: Locked overhead frame and autumn material
pages.body: A fixed 90° overhead camera, identity lock, autumn rug, walnut floor and fan shadow keep four looks in one spatial relationship.

images.caption: Fixed overhead autumn fashion frame
The fan as a foreground occlusion layer

pages.title: Full occlusion wardrobe change
pages.body: The fan covers the subject at about 07, 14 and 21 seconds; those are the only wardrobe windows, while face, body, light and shadow remain continuous.

images.caption: Material and shadow continuity after the occlusion
